description: arXiv:2608.20374v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: How precisely can we tell a language model how to feel? Most work on emotional generation answers with a discrete label - happy, angry, sad - which cannot express a target like "mildly downcast but calm." We instead specify the desired affect as a continuous point (v*, a*) in the Valence-Arousal plane and train the model to hit it. Our m...
